Progress checkpoint 2026-08-25T00:45:00Z

- Gerrit change 2202 remains the only change owned by this session. Patchset 1 holds LLM-Review -1 and Verified -1.
- The rebar-debug correction completed with a process-level RED oracle held out from both implementation agents. The final oracle covers all nineteen Jira adapter operations used by the connected probes. It was RED against import-only preflight, GREEN after correction, and RED again under a defect-seeded missing check. A post-GREEN domain assessment approved the result.
- Both scripts now use the Jira adapter ownership model. The field probe no longer uses associative arrays and reaches intended preflight output under Bash 3.2. JIRA_PROJECT remains mandatory with no fallback project. Unrelated temporary log cleanup was removed from scope.
- The branch rebased twice onto origin/main and now points to eba7d50dc49518913abfc0cfb7ac8d1a27073610. Focused tests, lint, type checking, ShellCheck, syntax checks, and commit ticket verification pass.
- The full suite recorded 16,761 passes, 64 skips, and one unrelated setup timeout after two hours of concurrent local load. The timeout occurred in git rev-parse HEAD before the test body. Five direct probes completed in under one hundredth of a second, and the isolated test passed. No repository state race was confirmed.
- The next action is one replacement patchset for Gerrit 2202, followed by waiting for both bot gates before submit.
